answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a raven guarding one nest on an island: one identity, one bond. A newcomer starts in the open meadow with no reputation and tiny earning limits, gaining trust only through verified work over time. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means posting a thousand stakes and completing a thousand honest jobs first, which costs far more than any Sybil attack can gain.
